explanation: For every ending position, record the length of a dictionary word that follows a reachable prefix. If the entire string is reachable, walk those recorded lengths backwards and reverse the resulting word sequence.
timeComplexity: O(n³) worst case including Java substring creation and hashing
spaceComplexity: O(n) live working space plus returned words
